chapter: Stuff Smith stories, Wes Montgomery and singers
title: Duke calling Jones a member of the musical family
summary: Willard notes Duke identified Jones as family in Music Is My Mistress and often asked for him.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: And speaking of the Ellington family, that's what Duke identified you as a member of the musical family, in "Music Is My Mistress."
Yeah. That was kind of him. You know, that's quite a credit.
Yes, it certainly is. But you became a member of the Ellington family there. I mean lots of times I'd hear him say, "Call Jimmy Jones. Let's get Jimmy Jones on this."
Yeah. I grew into it, you know, as time went along.
He depended upon you for things.
Yeah, I know, and I depended upon him.
